first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Certify Java sine and cosine rounding bounds (verification pending)
commits.body:
Strict native checks enclose each reachable angle with exact rational Taylor sums and consider both adjacent binary64 values permitted by Java. The host approximation only suggests a bracket. A counterexample must hold across all rounding choices, and arguments without a certificate stay open. This carries the original cube construction beyond the rounded value of negative pi over two.

The selected tests passed 17 of 17. Public floating-point controls passed on Temurin 21 and 25, including the change of sign across a quadrant, a fully replayed false claim and an open implementation-dependent last bit. Both directed endpoints matched an independent 4096-bit MPFR calculation on 216 evaluations. Job 20261120-091126-trace-cube-intersections-across-certifie repeats the four six-ray claims on both original revisions at their existing bounds.

commits.summary: Follow live ArrayList iterators through BSP nodes (verification pending)
commits.body:
Traverse the selected JDK ArrayList and its real cursor on one checker heap, including structural removal and fail-fast checks. The concrete interpreter keeps the backing list, cursor and modification count of an exact ArrayList so set, remove and stale traversal are observable through aliases. Explicitly requested list models retain their own layout.

The affected Rust suite passed. Native proofs, interpreter calls and direct JVM controls on Temurin 21 and 25 covered replacement, removal and continued traversal, double removal, exhaustion and concurrent modification, and a false snapshot claim reproduced. An original-bounds probe proved hit presence on all six fixed cube rays. Job 20261120-091739-verify-both-original-cube-repairs-throug checks all four geometry claims; 20261120-092415-recheck-the-two-array-roots-after-geomet and 20261120-092415-recheck-released-lcs-after-geometry-supp repeat the two campaign regressions.

commits.summary: Record the native cube proof and both missing-hit witnesses
commits.body:
The two fixed Commons Geometry claims hold for the four diagonals and two face controls. The parent misses all four diagonals. Both native counterexamples independently reproduced on code 0, with a missing facet where exact rational intersection gives the origin. The four original geometry decisions bring strict native coverage to 107 of 125. The complete packet took 17.641 seconds, with 152 MiB peak native process RSS. The 197 array roots and published 308 LCS regressions both passed.

All 189 stored collector files for the four jobs match the committed results. The public example validator rechecked the original six-row JVM streams on each revision byte for byte. All three examples passed validation, 360 report links resolved, and both 197 streams retained all 71 rows and their original hashes.

commits.summary: Check Joda-Time against captured UTC startup (verification pending)
commits.body:
The initializer observer now carries immutable application values with all final scalar and String fields, validates the bytes and full layout of every declaring class, and restores aliases, hidden fields and distinct objects. The checker follows the actual JDK string copy, nested ArrayList sublists and historical chronology caches. The concrete interpreter keeps sublists backed by their root array list and detects stale views. Ten additional source claims bind the observed DateTimeZone and DateTimeUtils states while keeping the ten original startup obligations intact.

The 25 selected test groups passed. A JBMC process-status stand-in failed once and passed on its automatic retry. Direct and distinguishing controls on Temurin 21 and 25 cover hidden inherited fields, copied Strings, nested list aliases, removal and invalidation. The public registry validated all twenty Joda claim keys and their plans. Capped probes proved the fixed signed day count for all 25 pairs and independently replayed a differing parent result. Job 20261120-094050-verify-monthday-distances-on-observed-ut checks all ten additional claims with distinct receipts and JVM correspondence.

commits.summary: Check integral objects in exception messages (verification pending)
commits.body:
StringBuilder.append(Object) renders the initialized signed value of final Byte, Short, Integer and Long wrappers with the same decimal conversion used for their primitive overloads. This preserves the actual Joda-Time exception construction reached on leap-day inputs.

The typed string fixture and direct JVM controls passed, including a negative boxed Integer beside a boxed Long. A capped native probe proved the historical parent reversal conditional on both real calls returning. Seven of the previous ten scoped tasks already met their expectations. Job 20261120-100118-verify-all-partial-date-claims-through-b repeats all ten including the three that reached the boxed-message gap.

commits.summary: Check chart endpoints under observed UTC calendars (verification pending)
commits.body:
Check the complete civil fields used by JFreeChart against an independently identified JDK calendar environment. The observer checks the default and explicit UTC factories, their concrete Gregorian calendar and zone types, era, leniency and cutover. Strict checking computes epoch milliseconds for canonical years 1600 through 9999, preserves the Date snapshot, and refuses incomplete dates or a changed locale. Eight companion claims require the observed startup digest and exact calendar assumption, alongside the original unmodified claims.

The actual selected JDK executes array-backed list traversal, floating wrapper conversion and EventObject construction. Object.clone shallow-copies the fields of a known Cloneable application object. Numerical extrema cover every NaN payload and sign, with raw-encoding refusals where Java leaves the result unspecified. Native and independent controls on Temurin 21 and 25 covered century leap rules, pre-epoch dates, UTC versus Tokyo, incomplete dates, array/list aliases, clones, NaNs and replayed counterexamples. All 27 changed-test groups passed after fixing the typed copy used by existing list conversions. The public chart example validated all 17 tasks. Original-bounds probes proved the fixed lower endpoint and reproduced the parent upper-endpoint violation.

Job 20261120-100439-verify-chart-ranges-on-observed-calendar checks all eight new claims. Jobs 20261120-100759-check-array-view-and-platform-conformanc and 20261120-100812-confirm-jvm-corpus-results-on-the-calend compare the conformance corpus under JBMC, auto and auto-confirm. Jobs 20261120-100812-confirm-array-root-observations-on-the-c and 20261120-100812-recheck-released-lcs-on-the-calendar-che repeat the original regressions. Job 20261120-101603-check-earlier-threeten-chronology-bindin rechecks the earlier ThreeTenBP state digest and complete clock grids.

commits.summary: Record eighteen native results with their JVM startup conditions
commits.body:
The original campaign has 78 native proofs, 29 independently replayed refutations and 18 open startup obligations. The eight chart and ten partial-date companion claims add 14 proofs and four replayed counterexamples on explicitly captured JDK 21 startup states. Together these outcomes agree with all 125 exhaustive JVM dispositions. Keep both scopes in the public register, including each subject, assumption, admitted count, witness, duration and peak process RSS.

All six affected examples validated and all 43 selected test groups passed. Each scoped claim matched the original guard, bounds, class bytes, ordered jars, full independent JVM stream and source control. The claimed initializer class hashes matched the actual bytes on both revisions. All 770 files from the first ten jobs matched the collector. The earlier 36,864-pair ThreeTen chronology grids retained their five verdicts and existing state digest. Both original array-root witnesses and the released LCS score passed again. A separate 3,068,037-date UTC sweep produced the same millisecond stream in Rust and on Temurin 21 and 25. The report's 390 links resolved.

commits.summary: Pair original startup checks with observed runs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Recheck all eight original chart tasks and all ten original partial-date tasks on exactly the respective binary that decided their observed-startup companions. These negative controls require the original strict query to run, to name the ambient initializer call and to publish an unresolved receipt. They reject an unrelated error, changed binary or hidden observed-initializer assumption.

Both job schemas validated and the checks on receipt stage, gap mode and source binding matched all 18 earlier original diagnostics. The changed-test selector chose no inline tests for the manifests. Jobs 20261120-103714-check-chart-startup-without-a-captured-c and 20261120-103714-check-partial-dates-without-captured-pro retain the original 30-second checker budgets, JDK, classpaths, guards and observers.
